extracted.name: Italian Dipping Oil
extracted.description: This Italian dipping oil is a delicious herb-infused olive oil that pairs well with Italian breads. Once you try this, you'll want it all the time!
instruction_lines: Grind pepper flakes, pepper, oregano, rosemary, basil, parsley, garlic powder, garlic, and salt together in a spice or coffee grinder.
Sprinkle 2 teaspoons herb mixture onto four small plates. Pour a thin layer of olive oil on top and serve. Store remaining herb mixture in an airtight container.
